# What do no-shows and late cancels cost your practice?

> Free no-show cost calculator for dental, medical, therapy, chiropractic, vet and salon practices: annual revenue lost to no-shows and late cancels, cost after refills, best overbooking level from an exact binomial model, break-even no-show fee and reminder price. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
